Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
March 10, 2015
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 200 Civic Center Drive, Vista, California
ROLL CALL
Recommended Action:
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE *3
BROWN ACT NOTICE OF SIMULTANEOUS MEETING COMPENSATION
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/BSD/SA)
C3.
CIP 8277 Reimbursement for the Installation of Sewer Improvements (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2015- , approving an agreement with North Santa Fe Housing Associates, L.P., regarding reimbursement for the installation of public improvements.
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2015- , amending the Capital Improvement Program Budget for FY 2014/15.
C4.
First Amendment to Communications Site Lease Agreement with Sprint PCS Assets, LLC at 340 Townsite Drive (CC)
C5.
Agreement for the Production & Distribution of the City Newsletter/RecGuide (CC)
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Presentation of Vehicle Theft Recognition Certificate to Deputy Tyler Eikermann in recognition of his contribution towards the reduction of stolen vehicle crimes in Vista.
PUBLIC HEARINGS
PH1.
Residential Care Facilities for the Elderly, C-1 Zone Amendment (CC)
1.
Open, conduct, and close a Public Hearing to consider a proposed amendment to Chapter 18.38 of the Development Code, C-1 Zone, to allow residential care facilities for the elderly with a special use permit.
2.
Introduce and adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2015- , entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending the C-1 Commercial Zone, Chapter 18.38 of the Development Code Relating to Residential Care Facilities for the Elderly."
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
